svg.text: Web tier (Nginx + React) · App tier (Node.js API) · Database tier (Amazon RDS PostgreSQL) · CI/CD with GitHub Actions · all infrastructure created by Terraform
listener HTTP :80 → target group eventra-web-tg (target type IP, health check /healthz)
ECS service eventra-web · port 80 · no public IP
serves static build, proxies /api → app tier
extra tasks may run on FARGATE_SPOT
outbound HTTPS via NAT (ECR, secrets, logs)
DB subnet group spans both AZs
with automatic failover (off to save cost)
Security groups — least privilege, each tier accepts only the tier in front of it
Internet ─80→ alb-sg ─80→ web-sg ─4000→ app-sg ─5432→ db-sg (db-sg has no outbound rules)
Only the ALB and NAT instance sit in public subnets; web/app tasks have no public IP; RDS has no internet route.
Web/app egress: 443 → NAT (ECR, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) · web → app 4000 · app → db 5432.
repos eventra-web, eventra-app · tag = commit SHA
scan on push · lifecycle keeps 10 images
JWT secret, admin login → injected at task start
GitHub OIDC provider + deploy role (repo + main only)
ECS execution role (1 secret) · task role (no perms)
web also ALB requests/target 500 · min 1 max 3
app tier reachable only inside the cluster
update ECS services (new task definition revision)
